scope: Bounded exploratory development on already disclosed V3 roles; no independent confirmation
action_within_decision_interval: fixed; six 8-step transactions or one 48-step transaction
rejected_transaction: restore current slice parameters, optimizer, incoming gradients and RNG; keep earlier accepted prefixes; scheduled time and compute remain consumed
zero_action: execute and charge scheduled gradients and guard; no parameter/momentum advance; not terminal stopping
parameter_capacity: unchanged V3 eight rank-eight adapters and frozen original model
adaptive_preprocessing: unchanged frozen V4 fourteen-coordinate initial origin translation; same information for field and richer
heads: unchanged selected V3 field and richer heads, normalizers and ridge
gate: unique predicted best action and predicted best-minus-baseline strictly greater than shared seed tau; otherwise baseline
tau_rule: maximum absolute old whole-trajectory OOF action-minus-baseline residual across both selected field/richer heads, all four actions and all 24 rows
source_registry: unchanged V3 allocation; all six roles have already been disclosed
endpoint_barrier: all 72 training paths sealed and checked before any V5 endpoint evaluation
inference: descriptive fixed-model means only; old development is not a fresh confidence test
cost: record all actual gradient, feature, teacher, observer, guard, rejected work, checkpoint and phase CPU/wall; ordinary does not pay unused feature instrumentation
